ModMetaData.name: RMVF · Mechanical examples / 机械示例
ModMetaData.author: Grey·Oviin/OpenAI Assisted
ModMetaData.description: Animation examples: a rotating arm, a folding and lifting mechanism, and a triple turret. Build them under Misc and open Animation controls. The turret demonstrates motion and does not fire projectiles. Requires Mechanical Visual Framework. 动画示例包含转臂、升降折叠机构和三联装炮塔。在“杂项”菜单建造后，选中建筑并打开“动画控制”。炮塔演示机械运动，不发射弹丸。需要启用机械动态视觉框架。
